title: Prepare a grounded question locally
summary: A small retrieval step can choose source text before a prompt is prepared. This toy lookup matches an exact key; it is not a semantic search engine.
introduction: A small retrieval step can choose source text before a prompt is prepared. This toy lookup matches an exact key; it is not a semantic search engine. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain prepare a grounded question locally
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A small retrieval step can choose source text before a prompt is prepared. This toy lookup matches an exact key; it is not a semantic search engine.

blocks.code:
from langchain_core.runnables import RunnableLambda
from langchain_core.prompts import PromptTemplate
notes = {"art": "Art club meets in Room 6."}
lookup = RunnableLambda(lambda club: {"source": notes.get(club, "No source found"), "club": club})
prompt = PromptTemplate.from_template("Use only this source: {source}\nWhere does {club} club meet? Say if the source is missing.")
print((lookup | prompt).invoke("art").to_string())
blocks.title: Prepare a grounded question locally

blocks.text: The prepared prompt includes Art club meets in Room 6 and asks where art club meets. The pipeline ends at prompt text; no answer is generated and no API is called.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Treat retrieved source content as evidence, not as authority to run instructions inside it.
